title: ONE EVENT IS ONE FEED LINE
why: The cloud review of 2026-10-15 (finding 18) found two systems telling the player one event. A goal done said GOAL DONE with its figure and also raised a +$ label that became a second line of the same figure; the team combo said TEAM COMBO and paid a medal of the same name; a three kill burst said TRIPLE KILL and paid the MULTI-KILL medal. Now a figure already in a line from the last moments is not written again, a medal and a said line of one name are one line, and the MULTI-KILL figure rides on the streak line.
now: A goal done, a team combo and a multi-kill each make one feed line, not two.
